scope: Complete diagonal source-torus DVR/Puiseux atlas over the two component-20 zero-restriction base points (p,q)=(0,1),(-1,0), for arbitrary positive local valuations/residues and D=diag(c0*t^x0,c1*t^x1,c2*t^x2,1), including exact nonzero-P4 min-plus locus, leading planes, rank profiles, component-placement evidence, centre symmetry, and pointwise H31/H22 obstructions.
method: Exact symbolic Plucker limits, Z3 real-linear min-plus exhaustion on every ultrametric branch and exact axis, exact SymPy minors/permanents for all 16 charts, explicit centre isomorphism, and pointwise Hall-support arguments.

placement_by_stratum.interior: component 20 and component 18 closures; additionally component 15 iff the profile has rank 2
placement_by_stratum.wall: component 20 and component 16 closures; not the component 18 common-singleton family

limitations: Independently verified construction output; the discovery claim label remains CANDIDATE.
The exhaustion covers diagonal source-torus DVR/Puiseux arcs only; it does not classify arbitrary non-diagonal source changes.
Component placement records closure inclusions, not equality or uniqueness of irreducible component.
The H31/H22 conclusions are pointwise necessary-condition obstructions for the displayed limiting Segre directions.
No finite-field computation is used, and no conclusion here resolves the global Krenn-Gu conjecture.
